name: iAgentBench
description: iAgentBench is a dynamic open-domain question answering benchmark designed to evaluate the sensemaking capabilities of information-seeking agents on high-traffic topics. It focuses on questions that require integrating evidence from multiple sources, tracking causal links, and resolving dependencies, reflecting realistic user information-seeking behavior.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly of interest for evaluating information-seeking agents on dynamic open-domain QA.
notes: Includes traceable evidence and auditable intermediate artifacts for contamination checks and fine-grained failure diagnosis.
